title: Sentinel-1D user data opening from 17 April 2026 — three-satellite SAR constellation
snippet: ESA Copernicus — Sentinel-1D satellite user data opened from 17 April 2026, completing the three-satellite Sentinel-1 SAR constellation (Sentinel-1A, 1C, 1D). Enhanced revisit time enables more frequent SAR monitoring for disasters, ice, deformation, and maritime surveillance worldwide.
tag_reason: New infrastructure event; Sentinel-1D data opening completes three-satellite SAR constellation — significant for global EO monitoring capability.
